limitations: This validates the saved Los Angeles 2022 Tour evidence bundle and its canonical reconciliation; it does not establish complete Discord, social-media, private, or deleted-evidence coverage.
Ten visible previous-best runs lack independently established publication dates and competing-record order, so they remain outside confirmed progression.
Nozomi's 1:34.78 and Seboss's 1:33.96 have text or message splits that conflict with their surviving images; neither is treated as a confirmed WR.
The original 1:33.82 video is unavailable, although its result image and posted lap splits survive.
Single-lap demonstrations and no-item runs are preserved separately and do not count as overall WRs.
One discussion-image ledger entry is an excluded personal photo and intentionally has no preserved evidence path.
The two closing standings tables were recaptured in the following Sky Tour discussion window; they support the final visible leaders, not every progression date.
Original video backups remain queued after the YouTube daily upload limit; no unavailable upload was claimed as complete.
